title: The Index/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Nef Anyo: "Has the Void been good to you? Has it taken your seed and turned it into a tree of wealth? Well, what if I told you the Void could turn that wealth into a fortune? It can, but only if you have faith. Ask yourself, 'Do I trust in the Void? Am I willing to put my investment into its glorious hands? Is my belief strong enough to reap its massive rewards?' Believer, if you're crying out 'YES!', then The Index is for you. The Index, it's where investors of faith seek fortune."

- Nef Anyo: "Has the Void been good to you? Has it taken your seed and turned it into a tree of wealth? Well, what if I told you the Void could turn that wealth into a fortune? It can, but only if you have faith. Ask yourself, 'Do I trust in the Void? Am I willing to put my investment into its glorious hands? Is my belief strong enough to reap its massive rewards?' Believer, if you're crying out 'YES!', then The Index is for you. The Index, it's where investors of faith seek fortune."
- Nef Anyo: "So Tenno, you think you have what it take to be a broker on the Index? Allow me to educate you."
- Nef Anyo: "When you kill a broker, they will drop an Index point. Scramble. It's your job to pick it up before the other team does."
- Nef Anyo: "You may hold any number of Index points but know they are worthless until you deposit them into the bank. We call this Capitalization."
- Nef Anyo: "But if you die on your way to the bank, you'll drop all your points, leaving them vulnerable to all."
- Nef Anyo: "You see, the Index is a game of risk and reward. Hold too many points and you risk rewarding the other team. Tenno, you best make peace with the Void, the Index is about to begin."
- Sark: "Capitalists, are you ready for The Index?"
- Sark: "This is The Index! I'm Cephalon Sark, your unbiased host!"
- Sark: "Investors, ready your brokers. The Index is about to open!"
- Sark: "Investors nervous, brokers in position; The bell, about to ring. This is The Index!"
- Sark: "Who rules The Index? Find out when the bell rings!"
- Sark: "{Excited mood!} The Index begins soon!"
- Sark: "The bell! Start killing fishes!... er, brokers."
- Sark: "And the brokers start trading bullets!"
- Sark: "An eruption of chaos on the trading floor!"
- Sark: "This is why Sark wakes up in the morning, folks!"
- Sark: "Cephalon Sark is faking it 'til he makes it!"
- Sark: "Sark has no idea what happened to previous announcer! {Shifty eyes...}"
- Sark: "Cephalon Sark's been resequenced as an announcer! {Surprised look!}"
- Sark: "Cephalon Sark likes his new boss, Nef Anyo. Praise the Void!"
- Sark: "Who will swim to the top of the Index first?"
- Sark: "Capitalize, capitalize, capitalize! This is The Index!"
- Sark: "Can the Tenno fend off Nef's brokers to rise to the top of The Index?"
- Sark: "Lots of Investors on the floor today!"
- Nef Anyo: "Investors, welcome to the Index! May the Void bless your precious Credits!"
- Nef Anyo: "Investors, are you down on the Index? There's only one answer: invest more Credits! The Void rewards faith!"
- Sark: "That broker's carrying a lot of points! This is a risky transaction!"
- Sark: "Points in the bank mean credits in the pocket!"
- Sark: "Eyes on broker with many points, risky move."
- Sark: "Brokers holding many points look like shiny bait!"
- Sark: "Holding lots of points is dangerous... and thrilling!"
- Sark: "Watch this broker with a bucket load of Index points! Will they make it to the vault?"
- Sark: "The Tenno are swimming up The Index!"
- Sark: "Tenno rally on The Index! Dramatic."
- Sark: "Tenno rally drives Anyo Corp confidence down, down, down!"
- Nef Anyo: "Come on brokers. How long are you going to let them do this to you?"
- Nef Anyo: "Brokers, you need to turn this around. Your livelihood and life depend on it!"
- Sark: "Look at this! Nef's brokers are rallying and the Tenno are desperate!"
- Sark: "Nef's investors have to be smiling today!"
- Nef Anyo: "By the Void, keep it up!"
- Nef Anyo: "There's a bonus for each one of you at the end of this match!"
- Nef Anyo: "Do you see investors? This is why you choose Anyo Corp!"
- Sark: "Either side could take the The Index today."
- Sark: "The Analysts are at a loss to predict this outcome."
